defects: Hypothesis is stated as `Module.finrank ℚ K > 1` instead of gold's `Module.finrank ℚ K ≠ 1`; these are equivalent only via the extra fact that a number field always has finrank ℚ K ≥ 1, not a syntactically identical hypothesis

Uses the concrete ring of integers `𝓞 K` instead of gold's general `𝒪` with `[CommRing 𝒪] [Algebra 𝒪 K] [IsIntegralClosure 𝒪 ℤ K]`; mathematically equivalent since 𝓞 K is the canonical instance, but narrower in stated generality
